summary: First-party English and Turkish discovery found TKGM's public Parsel Sorgu viewer, the Kütahya Kadastro Müdürlüğü listing, and Kütahya Municipality's E-İmar page. Following the viewer's current JavaScript configuration, a bounded anonymous exact-point request returned one safe Polygon with native composite cadastral identity fields.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, viewer/config inspection, headers, endpoint, schema/CRS observations, and response status are recorded in city-3989-k-tahya.json. The unchanged response is retained only under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/3989/coord.json.

custodians.name: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü (TKGM)
custodians.scope: national cadastral parcel viewer and public CBS coordinate endpoint
custodians.evidence: official viewer, current viewer configuration, official service page, and live HTTP 200 response

custodians.name: Kütahya Kadastro Müdürlüğü
custodians.scope: local cadastral custodian listed by TKGM
custodians.evidence: official TKGM regional bağlı müdürlükler page

schemaAndCrs.fieldMapping: Native source fields are documented here; no source-specific raw attribute set is retained in a cohort GeoJSON.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [39.4172411721698, 29.9933893427155] was preserved and not shifted.
One exact-point Polygon is not citywide coverage.
No separate GeoJSON sample was retained because the live response has no standalone parcelId; raw unchanged evidence remains in ignored tmp storage.
Municipal E-İmar discovery is a procedure/map lead, not a separately qualified vector endpoint.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: Composite native identity semantics should be independently reviewed
Current endpoint behavior outside the exact point and its terms/rate limits were not tested
doNotInfer: An exact-point hit does not define Kütahya's boundary
Municipal E-İmar page does not prove an open parcel API
A bounded response does not establish citywide completeness
Packet completion does not mean source integration/admission
